answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 6047 Country: India Title: The question is: Is the business of providing Internet Service justified as the customer could use the internet for some Haraam purpose like surfing porn sites. Question: Assalaam o Alaikum The question is: Is the business of providing Internet Service justified as the customer could use the internet for some Haraam purpose like surfing porn sites. Answer ID: 6047 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 971/898=D/1429) If the internet is used for permissible purposes then providing internet services is lawful. One should not personally involve in unlawful things, if the costumer makes illegal use of it then he will be sinner and responsible for the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
